
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /exit  (/quit, /q)                         │
  │  Exit RadSim                                │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Quit RadSim gracefully.

  Usage:
    /exit
    /quit
    /q

  Details:
    Exits RadSim cleanly. You can also type 'exit' or 'quit' without the slash.

  Examples:
    $ /exit
    $ /quit

  Related: /kill
